name: Barrel Lid
desc: It was a barrel this morning. Nobody has asked where the rest of it went.

name: Pot Lid, Dented Twice
desc: Something was cast at it once and bounced. The cook has not stopped mentioning this.

name: Buckler, Previously Owned
desc: Previously owned by somebody who is not using it now, for reasons the seller declines to go into.

name: Spiked Boss, Regrettable
desc: The spikes point the wrong way for defence and exactly the right way for the other thing.

name: Saint's Doorplate
desc: Prised off a shrine door. Still refuses things out of habit, which is most of what a saint did.

name: Kite Shield of Modest Convictions
desc: Broad, dependable, and slower than the argument it is having.

name: Percussive Argument
desc: Rimmed in iron and swung like a closing statement.

name: Mirror-Backed Targe
desc: Whoever silvered the back of it did not explain why, and then left town rather promptly.

name: Tower Shield 'Absolutely Not'
desc: A door with opinions. You do not carry it so much as agree to go the same way.

name: Bladed Rondache
desc: Somebody put an edge on a shield. The guild has written to them about it twice.

name: Reliquary Shield, Contested
desc: Three temples claim the finger bone inside it. All three agree the shield works.

name: Aegis, Allegedly
desc: Allegedly divine. Certainly heavy. The two claims are supported by different people.

name: The Last Word in Doors
desc: Hung on a hall for two hundred years, taken down for a fight, and never hung back up.

name: Shield of the Absent Saint
desc: The saint is not in it. The saint has not been in it for some time. It has kept the habit.

name: Charm Against Weather
desc: Sold by a man who was extremely dry in a downpour, which is the only evidence offered.

name: Ward-Knot, Amateur
desc: Tied by somebody working from a diagram. It holds, and it is not the knot in the diagram.

name: Sigil of Deferred Impact
desc: The blow still happens. It happens to the sigil, later, and quietly.

name: Aegis Fetish, Secondhand
desc: Wound round with somebody else's hair. It works better than it should and nobody will say why.

name: The Standing Refusal
desc: A legal instrument, technically. It refuses harm on procedural grounds and has never lost.
